content.comment_body: Hello, can anyone assist in reading the BM counter value using the [product_name] module? The BM has article number [article_no].
With the current firmware version of the [product_name], you should be able to do it. Please refer to the latest version of the manual for [product_name] for guidance.
I have figured out a solution.
Using your method, you can only read the value accurately when it is less than 32,768. For any value greater than 32,767, the output on AQ3 remains fixed at 32,767.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users discuss methods for reading a BM counter value through the [product_name] module, identifying a limitation where the output caps at 32,767 for values above this threshold. Accurate value retrieval is only possible for values below 32,768, highlighting a restriction influenced by the current firmware and the documentation for [product_name].
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to reliably read the entire range of BM counter values through the [product_name] module without limitation.
